name: Word reveal
description: Staggered words rise and fade into view.

name: Text scramble
description: Characters resolve progressively into readable text.

name: Count up
description: A numeric value approaches its target with cubic deceleration.

name: Typewriter
description: A phrase is revealed one character at a time.

name: Text wave
description: Individual characters follow a sinusoidal wave.

name: Gradient text
description: A moving color field is clipped to a stable text layer.

name: Pointer spotlight
description: A radial light follows the pointer inside a surface.

name: Perspective tilt
description: A surface tilts around its center and resets on exit.

name: Magnetic button
description: A control follows nearby pointer movement within bounded travel.

name: Particle field
description: Deterministic particles drift and connect to close neighbors.

name: Flow lines
description: Parallel lines bend through a time-varying sinusoidal field.

name: Orbit system
description: Points revolve on elliptical paths at different speeds.

name: Ripple field
description: Clicking the canvas emits expanding circular waves.

name: Noise field
description: A seeded monochrome grain field changes over time.

name: Aurora field
description: Soft moving color ribbons are composited on a dark field.

name: Dot wave
description: A grid of dots changes radius according to a wave field.
